title: ARV Catalog
description: The catalog document (arv.json) an origin publishes: its assets and moments.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

origin.description: The publishing origin used in every moment id preimage.

removed.description: Changes read (since): ids of assets this catalog listed once and does not list now. First page of a walk only. Absent on a full read.

until.description: Changes read: the opaque anchor of the walk, fixed on the first page. Every page carries it. Pass it back as until to read the rest of the walk.

next_after.description: Changes read: more changed assets remain. Pass it as after, with the same since and until, to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

next_since.description: Changes read: the opaque cursor to pass as since on the next walk. Last page only.
